anzsic_codes.name: Computer System Design and Related Services

merger_description:
The proposed transaction concerns the acquisition of control over Myriad360, LLC and its direct and indirect subsidiaries (together, **Myriad360**) by a newly formed entity, Metronome Bidco, LLC (**OEP Acquirer**), which is ultimately controlled by funds managed and/or advised by One Equity Partners (the **Acquisition**).

Pursuant to an Equity Purchase Agreement, OEP Acquirer will acquire 100% of the shares in Myriad360. Approximately 51% of the shareholdings in OEP Acquirer will be indirectly owned by funds managed and/or advised by One Equity Partners, and the existing shareholders (which primarily consist of management) will roll over to hold a minority non-controlling interest in the business.

One Equity Partners is a US-based middle market private equity firm that invests in businesses across the industrial, healthcare, and technology sectors, primarily in North America and Europe. One Equity Partners controls a portfolio of companies globally, some of which are active in aspects of the information technology (**IT**) sector, including software development, IT consulting and reselling, and managed IT services.

Myriad360 is a US-based IT services and consulting firm that helps enterprises design, implement, and manage technology environments. In providing these services, Myriad360 is a vendor-agnostic global reseller of networking and cybersecurity infrastructure to enterprise customers. Its activities include the supply of data centre infrastructure and networking solutions, cybersecurity, cloud services, artificial intelligence, and IT infrastructure and hardware procurement.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application, and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information currently before it, the ACCC considers that
the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material lessening of
competition given:
a. there is limited horizontal overlap between certain controlled
portfolio companies of One Equity Partners and Myriad360
in the supply of managed IT services in Australia
b. the parties’ combined share of supply of managed IT
services in Australia is estimated to be low and the
increment arising from the Acquisition is expected to be
small
c. there are alternative providers of managed IT services
available to customers in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
